platforms.name: KALX Music Director Physical Airplay Submission Route
platforms.country: United States / Berkeley freeform campus-community radio with a global web audience
platforms.feeAmount: No submission fee, account, login, CAPTCHA or mandatory payment is stated. The submitter must bear the cost of producing an eligible professionally pressed CD or LP and any international postage or customs charges.
platforms.manualReviewReason: KALX accepts only professionally pressed physical CDs or LPs for Music Director review and explicitly rejects downloads, file transfers, streaming links, digital forms and CD-Rs. A human must confirm that MarcsMusic has an eligible physical release, verify rights and release status, select a suitable record, confirm the current postal address, prepare the package and customs information, approve production and postage costs and mail it manually. The published Music Director email is not an authorized digital delivery route.
platforms.notes: Verified on 2026-07-13 from the official KALX contact, FAQ, specialty-programme and homepage pages. KALX directs eligible professionally pressed CDs or LPs to KALX, Attn: Music Director, University of California, 26 Social Sciences Building #5650, Berkeley, CA 94720-5650. The station states that it does not accept downloads, file transfers, Bandcamp, Spotify, YouTube, CD-Rs or digital submission forms. music@kalx.berkeley.edu is officially published for Music Directors Dasha Shevchenko and Ava Hoener, but the page does not authorize it for digital music delivery; mail@kalx.berkeley.edu explicitly says not to send music submissions, interview requests or press releases. Current programming and July 2026 activity confirm an active freeform station with electronic, techno, house, jungle, experimental, world, reggae, dub and underground hip-hop relevance. No email, physical package or music was sent, no contact was guessed and no SMTP, MX, catch-all, mailbox-level or deliverability probe was performed.

platforms.name: WFMU Music Director Physical Review Submission Route
platforms.country: United States / New York-New Jersey freeform radio with a global online audience
platforms.feeAmount: No submission fee, account, login, CAPTCHA or mandatory payment is stated for the physical review route. The submitter must bear media-production, postage and any international customs costs.
platforms.manualReviewReason: WFMU accepts vinyl, CDs, CD-Rs and cassettes for physical review by the Music Director. A human must select the appropriate MarcsMusic release and format, verify rights and release status, confirm the current address and carrier route, prepare the package and customs information, approve all costs and send it manually. The separate Music Department contact page requires JavaScript and is treated only as a manual inquiry or follow-up route, not as permission to upload or deliver music digitally.
platforms.notes: Verified on 2026-07-13 from WFMU official Send Us Music, contact, Music Department mail and homepage pages. WFMU welcomes vinyl, CD, CD-R and cassette review copies. Postal submissions are directed to WFMU, c/o Jessica Romoff (Music Director), PO Box 2011, Jersey City, NJ 07303-2011; UPS or FedEx deliveries are directed to WFMU, Jessica Romoff, 43 Montgomery Street, 4th Floor, Jersey City, NJ 07302. The linked Music Department Mail Page contains name, email, subject and message fields and requires JavaScript; it does not publish a plaintext submission mailbox or authorize digital track delivery. Current playlists, archives and July 2026 station activity confirm that WFMU remains active. No form, message, package or music was submitted, no JavaScript protection was bypassed, no contact was guessed and no SMTP, MX, catch-all, mailbox-level or deliverability probe was performed.
